data.detail: 10th Anniversary revamp: Passive Primal Pact (3 HP bars, Feral state via Wound-breaking, enhanced claw BAs + Resilience/AS/MS); S1 Feral Swipe (line dmg + slow); S2 Claw Strike (dash + wide claw strike, Cd resets on losing a life); Ult Savage Maul (charge dmg + stun + knockback)

10th Anniversary revamp: S1 Volley Shot reworked (Powerball landing scales with MS, MS boost on kick with decay, no wall crossing, castable in control, ground time 2s >> 3s, no BA interrupt; Base Dmg 100-225 >> 75-150, Mana 60-85 >> 50-75); S2 Slide redesigned (no pullback, gains Powerball on slide end, dmg removed, Stun 0.5s >> 0.1s, Cd 7s flat >> 9-7s, Mana 60 >> 90); Ult Worldie redesigned (brief stun + decaying slow, no PDef reduction, knockback to max attack range 0.1s >> 0.5s, hero-priority bounce; Cast Range 5.6 >> 6, First Hit 250-450 (+83% TPA) >> 200-400 (+80% TPA), Bounce 150-270 (+50% TPA) >> 100-200 (+40% TPA))

Base AS 0.88 >> 1, PA Growth 10.5 >> 8, AS Growth 2.5% >> 2%; Passive reworked (2s Enhanced BA after skill dmg up to 4s, line dmg + HP regen 30 (+15% TPA) per hit + slow + range/AS up); S2: removed Hybrid Lifesteal, new 0.3s stun, 2nd cast unconditional, Cd 7s flat >> 10-8s; Ult first 4 strikes 150-270 >> 110-270, last slash 450-810 >> 330-810

Passive: 30% initial Crit Chance; Crits trigger extra Demonic Slash (still procs Berserker's Fury/Windtalker); S2 stun on hit, extra AS on hero hit; no longer Crits itself, dmg scales with 40% of Crit Chance/Damage; Ult: auto-cast death immunity 4s no damage, dmg up to +50% below 30% HP, Base 150-300 >> 300-600, bonus 50% TPA >> 180% Extra PA, Cd 42-35s >> 45s; Base MS 240 >> 260

Passive shield on 3rd BA (Cd 5s) >> every 8s, 500 >> 350, new +60% MS 1s on shield; S1 +20% MS toward heroes, +5 stacks on hero hit, stack gains 10/4 >> 12/5 (siege/other), hero kill 10 >> 12, ally siege assist 5 >> 6, cap 650 >> 1000, per-stack dmg 5 >> 3; S2 no MS boost, dmg 100-200 >> 200-300, max 200-400 >> 400-600

Passive Resolve from attacks 2 >> 3.5; S1 new fan hitbox at 0 stacks, Pulverize 220-520 >> 280-580, Spin 100-200 >> 80-180, Regen 5% >> 6% Max HP; S2 Sacred Lightning 50-100 (+25% PA) >> 110-310 (+50% PA) (triggers once); Ult Resolve regen 1-2 >> 0.5-2
Classic-mode Zilong: Passive enhanced BA 450 (+150% TPA) >> 360 (+120% TPA); Ult Cd 35-27s >> 43-35s
Classic-mode Akai: Passive max-HP BA dmg 2% >> 3%; S2 shield dmg 2% >> 3% Max HP; Ult knockback frequency increased
Ult 2nd cast removed; can move freely at reduced speed during Ult; removed passive soundwave bounce speed/frequency boost

Passive regen 25% >> 15% of clone PA, creep dmg 50 >> 65; clones: S1/S2 clone deals 60% dmg takes 150%, S4 clone 80%-100% dmg takes 120%; skill Cd held while clone alive: S1/2 Cd 10-8s >> 6.5-5s, dmg 200-400 >> 280-480; clone kill gold 26+(1.5*min) >> 10+(1.0*min); Ult slow 20% >> 25%, dmg 270-320 >> 270-300, Cd 6s >> 5s; S4 Cd 36-28s >> 32-22s
S1 dmg 350-700 >> 300-650, Cd 12.5-10s >> 15-12s; S2 Cd 12.5-10s >> 15-12s; Ult freezes location-targeted skills (e.g. Eudora Ult, Vexana S2), Cd 74-62s >> 90-66s
S1 dmg 200-350 >> 200-450, Cd 4s >> 3.5s; Ult bonus 80% PA >> 8% Max HP; Passive 3rd BA triggers in control, regen 40 (+10% Max HP)(+60% TMP) >> 12% Max HP (+80% TMP)
MS 250 >> 240; Passive new +10% MS in River
Passive: removed 1.5 HP per 1 Mana from equip/emblems; new +1 Mana per 2.5 Extra HP
S1 target-HP dmg 3%-4.5% >> 3.5%-5%, creep cap 75-350 >> 100-350; Passive Spell Vamp per Delight stack 0.75% >> 1.25%
S1 AS bonus 50%-75% >> 30%-55%, duration 3s >> 2.5s; S2 Muddles dmg transfer 60% >> 52%, attack-effect inheritance 80% >> 52%
Passive Moonlight Shadow dmg 30 (+25% TPA) >> 25 (+20% TPA); S1 fixed Split Arrow (clone) abnormal dmg/attack-effect bug
Passive new: repeated bounces on same target deal 30% less damage
Passive laser 80 (+80% Extra PA)(+8*Lv) >> 60 (+50% TPA)(+8*Lv); S2 regen per enemy hit 40-200 (+30% Extra PA) >> 80-330 (+40% Extra PA) with 40% decay on subsequent targets
S1 umbrella MS scales with move distance
S2 can pass through walls when ejecting from Phylax; Ult gains Wrath from skill dmg in Phylax, extra MS while flying, wall pass on eject, knockback no longer damages nearby enemies
S1 Cd 7s flat >> 6s; Enhanced BA dmg 150-225 (+55% TMP) >> 160-310 (+60% TMP)
Enhanced S2 dmg 350-750 >> 300-800 (min up, max down), bonus 230% TPA >> 210% TPA
S1 Cd 7s >> 5.5s; new HP regen +45% of Total MP
Mythical Honor BF only: S2 Cd 16-13s >> 13-10s
Mythical Honor BF: reverted skill values to global values
